response.sql: WITH id_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), total_exams AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM Examination), id_shares AS (SELECT ic.ID, ic.record_count, ic.record_count / te.total as share FROM id_counts ic CROSS JOIN total_exams te), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM id_shares) SELECT AVG(ids.record_count) as avg_record_count, AVG(ids.share) as avg_share, AVG(ids.share - asc.avg_share) as avg_beat FROM id_shares ids CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc WHERE ids.share > asc.avg_share
